COURT TRIAL
Off Calendar May-20-2002 Text Ruling
MINI MINUTES: Assigned for prove-up hearing. APPEARANCES: Plaintiff Marvin A. Remmich, with counsel, Saul M. Ferster, Esq. JUDGE: THOMAS J. MELLON, JR.; Clerk: Dan MacDuff; Reporter: Mary Hinds; Bailiff: Louise Pierotti. Plaintiff is sworn and examined; exhibits are admitted and returned to plaintiff's counsel. The court orders judgment for plaintiff, against all defendants, for restitution of the premises at 1440 Sacramento St., #12, San Francisco, CA, forfeiture of the lease agreement, for total damages of $3,234.03 plus costs according to proof. Judgment signed.
